observations: Photo shows a bare engine assembly removed from a vehicle, sitting on a paved surface.
Timing belt/chain cover, pulleys, intake manifold, and wiring harness connectors are visible.
A person's legs (jeans) are visible in the background, no vehicle or engine bay context shown.
A watermark reading something like 'KWARA MOBILE' is overlaid on the image.
No manufacturer logo, engine code sticker, casting number, or VIN/ID plate is legible anywhere on the block.
Surfaces show dirt, grease, and wear consistent with a used/removed engine, not a new one.

claims.claim: Direct America (implying imported used engine from the US)
claims.evidence: No shipping label, customs document, or container photo shown; cannot be confirmed from the engine photo alone.
No written warranty card, receipt, or seller shop signage shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Engine running condition (compression, leaks, unknown faults) cannot be judged from a static photo.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine running/idling with sound, plus a compression test reading if possible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed running (worst case, non-functional)

risks.risk: Make, model, and displacement are not identifiable, which drives most of the price for an engine.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code sticker, casting number on the block, or a VIN/parts tag.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without this; treated as unidentified generic unit

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history of the donor vehicle is unknown.
risks.proof: Odometer photo or vehicle history/import paperwork showing mileage.

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (sensors, starter, alternator, turbo if applicable) cannot be fully confirmed from one angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from front, rear, and both sides of the engine.

risks.risk: Origin claim ('Direct America') cannot be verified and affects perceived quality/trust.
risks.proof: Photo of shipping/import documents or container tag.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, treated as standard used import

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code sticker or casting number on the block (needed to identify make/model).
A short video of the engine running with audible sound.
Photos from the other three sides of the engine (front, rear, opposite side) showing completeness.
Any import/customs document or shipping tag supporting the 'Direct America' claim.
Photo of a written warranty/guarantee note from the seller, if one exists.
response.reason: The engine's make and model are not legible in the single photo, and model is the key factor for pricing an engine; a worst-case price cannot be set without at least an identifiable engine code or casting number.
